_doc: Vendored from cad-fork fixtures/golden/tolerances.json (brief I3): the platforms block, complete (abs_floor, determinism_rel and dev_*_coord_rel included). The fork must not import from the control repo at runtime, so the policy is copied; re-copy it when I3 recalibrates. test_refactor_invariant.py checks the numbers against the control repo file when it is present. The comparison mirrors harness/golden/compare.py: volume and area are relative to the quantity (rel_tol*max(|a|,|b|)), positions relative to the bounding-box diagonal, each plus abs_floor*diag**k; deviation limits are max(abs, rel*diag, coord_rel*largest |bbox coordinate|).
